3	description: >
4	  Bring up or audit the hybrid CSR transport for an Andes RISC-V core, given
5	  the AndeStar V5 SPA PDF spec and a built vsim engine. Covers the whole
6	  pipeline: mine the spec (CSR inventory, IM Requirement / existence
7	  conditions, access modes, reset values), classify transport dispositions,
8	  bind capability gates to the engine's config.inc, and validate with the
9	  Program-Buffer CSR sweep, --verify, and the e2e suite. Use this skill
10	  whenever the user mentions a new core, a new vsim engine, CSR transport /
11	  transportation, CSR capability or caps gating, IM Requirement, reset value
12	  table, which mode a CSR is supported in, csr_sweep cmderr faults, or
13	  --verify field mismatches on Andes/M-ext CSRs -- even if they do not say
14	  "bring-up" explicitly.
15	---
16	
17	# CSR transport bring-up for a new Andes core
18	
19	Inputs you need from the user (ask if missing):
20	- The AndeStar V5 SPA PDF for the core family (the repo carries
21	  `AndeStar_V5_SPA_UM164_V1.7.pdf` for the current cores).
22	- The engine name (e.g. `ax45mpv_premium`) and a built vsim checkout
23	  (`VSIM_BIN_DIR` in `config.env` points at its `build/`).
24	- Optionally the matching QEMU `-cpu` name for the oracle leg.
25	
26	The goal: every CSR the core implements and the ROI can touch is restored at
27	resume, re-read at drain, and `--verify`-compared -- and every CSR the core
28	does NOT implement is gated off, because the batched Program-Buffer sweep
29	faults (cmderr=3) on a single over-claimed CSR.
30	
31	Work in this order. Each phase has a reference file with the details --
32	read it when you reach the phase, not before.
33	
34	## Phase 0: establish ground truth
35	
36	The engine's compiled-in config is the ONLY truth about what it implements.
37	Read `$VSIM_BIN_DIR/V<engine>/obj_sc/config.inc` (the BUILD directory copy --
38	the `external/` source tree can differ from what was actually built) and
39	`sim_<engine> --describe`. Do not trust QEMU: its gdbstub exposes CSRs the
40	vsim RTL does not implement (QEMU models a fuller core), and restoring or
41	sweeping one of those stalls or faults the Debug Module.
42	
43	## Phase 1: mine the spec
44	
45	Run `scripts/extract_csr_inventory.py <spec.pdf>` to refresh
46	`tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv` (needs PyMuPDF; use a venv). Then pull,
47	for each CSR the core claims: the IM Requirement (existence condition), the
48	Access Mode, and the reset value. The SPA has a fixed per-CSR layout and a
49	consolidated existence table (Table 13) -- see
50	`references/spec-mining.md` for the exact headers and extraction recipes.
51	
52	## Phase 2: classify dispositions
53	
54	Run `scripts/classify_csr_coverage.py tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv` and
55	the guard `tests/andes_csr/check_coverage.py`. The guard enforces
56	inventory == matrix == ABI (`include/hybrid/state_abi.h`), so a CSR added to
57	the wire format without a disposition (or vice versa) fails loudly. New
58	transported CSRs are one X-macro line in `state_abi.h`
59	(`HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST` / `HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST`); every consumer
60	(plugin drain, restore, drain re-read, verify) iterates the same list.
61	
62	## Phase 3: bind capability gates
63	
64	For each transported CSR, map its IM Requirement to a gate in the vsim
65	repo's `src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp` (address -> gate) and bind the gate to a
66	`_NDS_*` config macro in `andes_caps_config.hpp` (absent macro reads as
67	"off" -- never a compile error). The gate must encode the SPEC's existence
68	condition, not a plausibly-related feature; two real bugs came from getting
69	this wrong. Follow TDD: model the new engine's config shape as a caps
70	helper in `tests/hybrid/andes_caps.test.cpp` and write the failing
71	expectation first. Read `references/caps-gating.md` -- it carries the
72	hard-won rules and the write-prerequisite (setup ordering) requirements.
73	
74	## Phase 4: reset values and verify exclusions
75	
76	Two reset-value sources exist and they legitimately differ:
77	- The SPA reset table (documentation; many fields are IM = implementation
78	  determined or DC = don't care).
79	- The EMPIRICAL baseline the simulator drains from the freshly reset hart
80	  (cached per engine build + ELF). The liveness gate compares against this
81	  one -- it is self-truthing, so spec IM/DC values need no manual table.
82	
83	Where QEMU's reset differs from the engine's reset for a CSR the program
84	never writes (e.g. `msp_bound`, `milmb` enable bit), a strict compare
85	false-positives: add it to `andes_verify_excluded` in
86	`driver/state_diff.cpp` with a comment naming the divergence. Do NOT
87	exclude a CSR to hide a transport bug -- exclusion is only for
88	engine-implementation artifacts.
89	
90	## Phase 5: validate (the ladder)
91	
92	Run bottom-up; each rung catches what the one below cannot. The key
93	insight: the tolerant abstract path MASKS capability bugs (a faulting read
94	mirrors as zero, QEMU drains zero too, --verify falsely matches), so only
95	the batched CSR sweep truly validates the caps table -- it faults on an
96	over-claim and bisects to NAME the offending CSR. A cold-cache hybrid run
97	exercises it via the baseline capture. Full commands, expected outputs, and
98	failure playbook: `references/validation.md`.
99	
100	## Phase 6: commit and document
101	
102	TDD and Tidy First apply: caps fixes, sweep/transport changes, and docs are
103	separate commits, each on a green suite. Update the vsim `ROADMAP.md`
104	known-limits and `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` (section 4.4 documents what --verify
105	compares). Update `tests/andes_csr/csr_coverage.csv` through the classifier,
106	never by hand -- the guard checks policy == matrix.
107

  transportation, CSR capability or caps gating, IM Requirement, reset value
  table, which mode a CSR is supported in, csr_sweep cmderr faults, or
  --verify field mismatches on Andes/M-ext CSRs -- even if they do not say
  "bring-up" explicitly.
---

# CSR transport bring-up for a new Andes core

Inputs you need from the user (ask if missing):
- The AndeStar V5 SPA PDF for the core family (the repo carries
  `AndeStar_V5_SPA_UM164_V1.7.pdf` for the current cores).
- The engine name (e.g. `ax45mpv_premium`) and a built vsim checkout
  (`VSIM_BIN_DIR` in `config.env` points at its `build/`).
- Optionally the matching QEMU `-cpu` name for the oracle leg.

The goal: every CSR the core implements and the ROI can touch is restored at
resume, re-read at drain, and `--verify`-compared -- and every CSR the core
does NOT implement is gated off, because the batched Program-Buffer sweep
faults (cmderr=3) on a single over-claimed CSR.

Work in this order. Each phase has a reference file with the details --
read it when you reach the phase, not before.

## Phase 0: establish ground truth

The engine's compiled-in config is the ONLY truth about what it implements.
Read `$VSIM_BIN_DIR/V<engine>/obj_sc/config.inc` (the BUILD directory copy --
the `external/` source tree can differ from what was actually built) and
`sim_<engine> --describe`. Do not trust QEMU: its gdbstub exposes CSRs the
vsim RTL does not implement (QEMU models a fuller core), and restoring or
sweeping one of those stalls or faults the Debug Module.

## Phase 1: mine the spec

Run `scripts/extract_csr_inventory.py <spec.pdf>` to refresh
`tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv` (needs PyMuPDF; use a venv). Then pull,
for each CSR the core claims: the IM Requirement (existence condition), the
Access Mode, and the reset value. The SPA has a fixed per-CSR layout and a
consolidated existence table (Table 13) -- see
`references/spec-mining.md` for the exact headers and extraction recipes.

## Phase 2: classify dispositions

Run `scripts/classify_csr_coverage.py tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv` and
the guard `tests/andes_csr/check_coverage.py`. The guard enforces
inventory == matrix == ABI (`include/hybrid/state_abi.h`), so a CSR added to
the wire format without a disposition (or vice versa) fails loudly. New
transported CSRs are one X-macro line in `state_abi.h`
(`HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST` / `HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST`); every consumer
(plugin drain, restore, drain re-read, verify) iterates the same list.

## Phase 3: bind capability gates

For each transported CSR, map its IM Requirement to a gate in the vsim
repo's `src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp` (address -> gate) and bind the gate to a
`_NDS_*` config macro in `andes_caps_config.hpp` (absent macro reads as
"off" -- never a compile error). The gate must encode the SPEC's existence
condition, not a plausibly-related feature; two real bugs came from getting
this wrong. Follow TDD: model the new engine's config shape as a caps
helper in `tests/hybrid/andes_caps.test.cpp` and write the failing
expectation first. Read `references/caps-gating.md` -- it carries the
hard-won rules and the write-prerequisite (setup ordering) requirements.

## Phase 4: reset values and verify exclusions

Two reset-value sources exist and they legitimately differ:
- The SPA reset table (documentation; many fields are IM = implementation
  determined or DC = don't care).
- The EMPIRICAL baseline the simulator drains from the freshly reset hart
  (cached per engine build + ELF). The liveness gate compares against this
  one -- it is self-truthing, so spec IM/DC values need no manual table.

Where QEMU's reset differs from the engine's reset for a CSR the program
never writes (e.g. `msp_bound`, `milmb` enable bit), a strict compare
false-positives: add it to `andes_verify_excluded` in
`driver/state_diff.cpp` with a comment naming the divergence. Do NOT
exclude a CSR to hide a transport bug -- exclusion is only for
engine-implementation artifacts.

## Phase 5: validate (the ladder)

Run bottom-up; each rung catches what the one below cannot. The key
insight: the tolerant abstract path MASKS capability bugs (a faulting read
mirrors as zero, QEMU drains zero too, --verify falsely matches), so only
the batched CSR sweep truly validates the caps table -- it faults on an
over-claim and bisects to NAME the offending CSR. A cold-cache hybrid run
exercises it via the baseline capture. Full commands, expected outputs, and
failure playbook: `references/validation.md`.

## Phase 6: commit and document

TDD and Tidy First apply: caps fixes, sweep/transport changes, and docs are
separate commits, each on a green suite. Update the vsim `ROADMAP.md`
known-limits and `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` (section 4.4 documents what --verify
compares). Update `tests/andes_csr/csr_coverage.csv` through the classifier,
never by hand -- the guard checks policy == matrix.

1	# Mining the AndeStar V5 SPA PDF
2	
3	## Extract text once, grep many times
4	
5	```sh
6	python -m venv /tmp/pdfvenv && /tmp/pdfvenv/bin/pip -q install pymupdf
7	/tmp/pdfvenv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
8	import fitz, sys
9	doc = fitz.open("AndeStar_V5_SPA_UM164_V1.7.pdf")
10	with open("/tmp/spa.txt", "w") as f:
11	    for i, page in enumerate(doc, 1):
12	        f.write(f"===PAGE {i}===\n" + page.get_text())
13	EOF
14	```
15	
16	The repo already automates the inventory step:
17	`scripts/extract_csr_inventory.py <spec.pdf> [out.csv]` writes
18	`tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv` (addr, privilege, name, mode, section).
19	Run it when the spec revision changes; the committed CSV is the checked-in
20	truth the coverage guard reads.
21	
22	## Per-CSR section layout (chapters 8-10)
23	
24	Every CSR gets a section with fixed headers -- grep for the mnemonic, then
25	read the block:
26	
27	```
28	8.3.8
29	User Scratch Register
30	Mnemonic Name: uscratch
31	IM Requirement: misa[13]==1 (N extension)     <- existence condition
32	Access Mode: User                              <- privilege mode
33	CSR Address: 0x040 (standard read/write)
34	XLEN: 64 and 32
35	<bit-field diagram: per-field name, type (RW/RO/W1C/...), reset value>
36	```
37	
38	- `IM Requirement:` is THE existence condition. This is what the caps gate
39	  must encode (Phase 3). "Always" means gate ALWAYS.
40	- `Access Mode:` gives the privilege mode the user asked about ("which mode
41	  supports this CSR"): Machine / Supervisor / User / Debug.
42	- Field types use the terminology page (chapter 9.1): IM = implementation
43	  determined, DC = reset value is don't care, RO/WO/RW/W1C/WS/RAZWI.
44	  IM and DC reset values CANNOT be tabled from the spec -- that is exactly
45	  why the empirical reset baseline (Phase 4) is the source the liveness
46	  gate uses.
47	
48	## Table 13: the consolidated existence table
49	
50	"Table 13: Existence configuration condition(s)" lists CSR groups against
51	their conditions in one place -- faster than walking every section, and the
52	authoritative cross-check when a per-section IM Requirement reads
53	ambiguously. Real rows:
54	
55	```
56	mcounterinten                 mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1
57	mcounterwen                   (mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[20]==1) // user
58	mcountermask_m
59	mcountermask_u
60	mcounterovf
61	mcountermask_s                (mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[18]==1) // supervisor
62	mcounteren                    misa[20]==1 // user mode
63	```
64	
65	Note the grouping: a condition line applies to the CSR names stacked above
66	it (PDF table extraction flattens the rows). `misa[20]` = U-mode present,
67	`misa[18]` = S-mode present. Cross-map to config.inc:
68	`NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 2` -> U-mode, `== 3` -> S-mode;
69	`mmsc_cfg.PMNDS` -> the Andes perf-monitor feature.
70	
71	## What "supported mode" means for transport
72	
73	The transport envelope is bare-metal, single-hart, trap-free ROI, M or M+U.
74	So:

# Mining the AndeStar V5 SPA PDF

## Extract text once, grep many times

```sh
python -m venv /tmp/pdfvenv && /tmp/pdfvenv/bin/pip -q install pymupdf
/tmp/pdfvenv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import fitz, sys
doc = fitz.open("AndeStar_V5_SPA_UM164_V1.7.pdf")
with open("/tmp/spa.txt", "w") as f:
    for i, page in enumerate(doc, 1):
        f.write(f"===PAGE {i}===\n" + page.get_text())
EOF
```

The repo already automates the inventory step:
`scripts/extract_csr_inventory.py <spec.pdf> [out.csv]` writes
`tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv` (addr, privilege, name, mode, section).
Run it when the spec revision changes; the committed CSV is the checked-in
truth the coverage guard reads.

## Per-CSR section layout (chapters 8-10)

Every CSR gets a section with fixed headers -- grep for the mnemonic, then
read the block:

```
8.3.8
User Scratch Register
Mnemonic Name: uscratch
IM Requirement: misa[13]==1 (N extension)     <- existence condition
Access Mode: User                              <- privilege mode
CSR Address: 0x040 (standard read/write)
XLEN: 64 and 32
<bit-field diagram: per-field name, type (RW/RO/W1C/...), reset value>
```

- `IM Requirement:` is THE existence condition. This is what the caps gate
  must encode (Phase 3). "Always" means gate ALWAYS.
- `Access Mode:` gives the privilege mode the user asked about ("which mode
  supports this CSR"): Machine / Supervisor / User / Debug.
- Field types use the terminology page (chapter 9.1): IM = implementation
  determined, DC = reset value is don't care, RO/WO/RW/W1C/WS/RAZWI.
  IM and DC reset values CANNOT be tabled from the spec -- that is exactly
  why the empirical reset baseline (Phase 4) is the source the liveness
  gate uses.

## Table 13: the consolidated existence table

"Table 13: Existence configuration condition(s)" lists CSR groups against
their conditions in one place -- faster than walking every section, and the
authoritative cross-check when a per-section IM Requirement reads
ambiguously. Real rows:

```
mcounterinten                 mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1
mcounterwen                   (mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[20]==1) // user
mcountermask_m
mcountermask_u
mcounterovf
mcountermask_s                (mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[18]==1) // supervisor
mcounteren                    misa[20]==1 // user mode
```

Note the grouping: a condition line applies to the CSR names stacked above
it (PDF table extraction flattens the rows). `misa[20]` = U-mode present,
`misa[18]` = S-mode present. Cross-map to config.inc:
`NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 2` -> U-mode, `== 3` -> S-mode;
`mmsc_cfg.PMNDS` -> the Andes perf-monitor feature.

## What "supported mode" means for transport

The transport envelope is bare-metal, single-hart, trap-free ROI, M or M+U.
So:
- M-mode CSRs (`0x3xx`, `0x7xx`, `0xBxx` machine): transport candidates.
- U-mode CSRs (`0x0xx`, `0x8xx`): transported only for the M+U envelope
  (disposition NEW_UDELTA) and gated on the UMODE gate.
- S-mode / Hypervisor / Debug-mode CSRs: excluded (EXCL_MODE / EXCL_DEBUG)
  until the S/U-envelope work needs them.
See `scripts/classify_csr_coverage.py`'s docstring for the full
disposition legend.

30

34	  --verify tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf

36

38	rides the batched PB sweep over the COMPLETE caps-supported list -- so a

40	RTL. One over-claim aborts the run with the bisected name:

45	```
46

48	until the capture is clean. Expect the `--verify` field count to DROP by
49	one per de-claimed CSR (e.g. premium went 146 -> 144 when 0x7D1 and 0x017
50	left the set) -- a drop is correct, those fields were zero-vs-zero
51	false matches before.

54	
55	`[state-diff] FAIL` lines name mismatching fields. Triage order:
56	- Field never restored/re-read? Missing from an X-macro consumer (should
57	  be impossible if the lists are used) or caps-gated off on one side.

85	dominated by DM op COUNT, not bytes:

95

97	
98	- The drain sweep runs only on FULL drains; the simulator lifts the swept
99	  scratch bytes (`read_csr_from_scratch`) under EXACTLY the same condition
100	  the drain used to choose sweep-vs-abstract (`csr_scratch_fits`, flags,
101	  and not-minimal) -- a lift without a sweep reads garbage; a sweep
102	  without a lift silently loses in-ROI CSR writes.
103	- Scratch page layout (top page of RAM): V data grows up from the base;
104	  GPR block at the top, FPR below it, CSR block below that. Every user is
105	  fits-gated on the live vlenb so a full V page falls back to abstract
106	  ops on both sides symmetrically.

3	// A core implements an Andes custom CSR only when the matching feature is
4	// configured into it (config.inc). Restoring a CSR the target core lacks can
5	// hang the DMI handshake -- observed on ax45mpv_premium for ucode (no DSP) and
6	// mecc_code (no ECC). So the resume/drain loops transport only the CSRs the
7	// target core supports, decided here from the core's feature gates.
8	//
9	// This header is Verilator/SystemC-free: it maps a CSR address to its gate and
10	// answers "does a core with these gates support this CSR". The binding of each
11	// gate to the core's compiled-in `_NDS_*` config macros lives in the sim binary
12	// (see andes_caps_from_config), so this stays unit-testable in isolation.
13	#ifndef ANDES_HYBRID_ANDES_CAPS_HPP

24	// The hardware feature that gates each transported CSR. ALWAYS = unconditionally
25	// present (a base machine CSR every core has; never gated off). The first block
26	// gates the v3 Andes custom CSRs; the second block (UMODE..TRIGGER) gates the v4
27	// M-ext CSRs (HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST) -- standard + Andes M-mode CSRs whose
28	// existence depends on a privilege level or extension the core may not have.
29	enum class AndesGate : uint8_t {
30	  ALWAYS = 0,
31	  DSP,
32	  CODENSE,
33	  ZCMT,        // standard Zcmt table jump (jvt); NOT implied by CoDense
34	  POWERBRAKE,
35	  STACKSAFE,
36	  ECC,
37	  PMA,
38	  ILM,
39	  DLM,

43	  // AND NOT SSCOFPMF -- a core with the standard Sscofpmf count-overflow
44	  // extension REPLACES the Andes scheme. The _UMODE/_SMODE variants add the
45	  // privilege term the spec conditions carry (PMNDS & misa[20] / misa[18]).
46	  PMNDS,        // Andes-scheme perf counters (perf monitor && !Sscofpmf)
47	  PMNDS_UMODE,  // PMNDS && U-mode
48	  PMNDS_SMODE,  // PMNDS && S-mode
49	  // v4 M-ext gates.
50	  UMODE,       // needs U-mode  (NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 2)
51	  SMODE,       // needs S-mode  (NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS == 3)
52	  EPMP,        // ePMP / Smepmp (mseccfg)
53	  SMRNMI,      // resumable NMI (mnscratch/mnepc/mncause/mnstatus/mnvec/mrnxvec)
54	  EXCSLVL,     // exception save levels (msave*)
55	  CLIC,        // CLIC / enhanced CLIC (mtvt/mintthresh/mcirq_entry)
56	  SMSTATEEN,   // state-enable (mstateen0..3)
57	  CCTL,        // cache control CSRs (mcctlbeginaddr/mcctldata)
58	  PPI,         // private peripheral interface base (mppib)
59	  FIO,         // fast IO base (mfiob)

66	// Maintainer note: a CSR added to HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST that needs gating must

75	    // ax45mpv_premium, where it aborted the drain CSR sweep).

78	    case 0x7C2: return AndesGate::ECC;            // mecc_code
79	    case 0x7C6:                                   // mhsp_ctl
80	    case 0x7C7:                                   // msp_bound

82	    case 0x7C0: return AndesGate::ILM;            // milmb (ILM base)
83	    case 0x7C1: return AndesGate::DLM;            // mdlmb (DLM base)

85	    // The PMNDS counter block (SPA existence: mmsc_cfg.PMNDS, plus misa[20]
86	    // or misa[18] for the U/S members). Over-claiming any of these faults a
87	    // PB csrr with cmderr=3, aborting a CSR sweep -- seen live for 0x7D1 on
88	    // premium (M-only) and 0x7CF on advanced (Sscofpmf replaces PMNDS).
89	    case 0x7CF: return AndesGate::PMNDS;          // mcounterinten
90	    case 0x7CE: case 0x7D1: case 0x7D3:           // mcounterwen, mcountermask_m/_u
91	      return AndesGate::PMNDS_UMODE;
92	    case 0x7D2: return AndesGate::PMNDS_SMODE;    // mcountermask_s
93	    case 0x30A: case 0x306:                       // menvcfg, mcounteren
94	    case 0x808: case 0x80B: case 0x811: case 0x813:  // uzobctl, ucctlbeginaddr, sleepvalue, umisc_ctl

96	    case 0x7D5: return AndesGate::SMODE;          // mslideleg

103	    case 0x740: case 0x741: case 0x742: case 0x744:  // mnscratch, mnepc, mncause, mnstatus
104	    case 0x7C3: case 0x7DE:                           // mnvec, mrnxvec

114	    case 0x7CB: case 0x7CD: return AndesGate::CCTL;  // mcctlbeginaddr, mcctldata
115	    case 0x7F0: return AndesGate::PPI;            // mppib
116	    case 0x7F1: return AndesGate::FIO;            // mfiob
117	    case 0x7A0: case 0x7A1: case 0x7A2: case 0x7A5: case 0x7A8:  // tselect, tdata1, tdata2, tcontrol, mcontext
118	      return AndesGate::TRIGGER;
119	    default:
120	      // PMA cfg (0xBC0, 0xBC2) and addr (0xBD0..0xBDF) blocks.
121	      if (csr_addr == HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR || csr_addr == HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR + 2)
122	        return AndesGate::PMA;
123	      if (csr_addr >= HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR &&
124	          csr_addr < HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR + HYBRID_PMA_ADDR_NUM)
125	        return AndesGate::PMA;
126	      return AndesGate::ALWAYS;                    // mxstatus 0x7C4, mclk_ctl 0x7DF
127	  }
128	}
129	
130	// The set of Andes feature gates a target core has on. Built from the core's
131	// compiled-in config (config.inc) in the sim binary and injected into the
132	// resume/drain loops, so they transport only the CSRs the core implements.
133	// Default = every gate on (all(): no gating, the prior unconditional behavior).
134	struct AndesCaps {
135	  uint32_t gate_mask = ~0u;
136	
137	  static constexpr AndesCaps all()  { return AndesCaps{~0u}; }
138	  static constexpr AndesCaps none() { return AndesCaps{0u}; }
139	
140	  constexpr void set(AndesGate g, bool on = true)
141	  {
142	    const uint32_t bit = 1u << static_cast<unsigned>(g);
143	    if (on) gate_mask |= bit;
144	    else    gate_mask &= ~bit;
145	  }
146	
147	  constexpr bool gate_on(AndesGate g) const
148	  {
149	    return (gate_mask >> static_cast<unsigned>(g)) & 1u;
150	  }
151	
152	  // ALWAYS-gated CSRs are present on every core regardless of the mask.
153	  constexpr bool supports_csr(uint16_t csr_addr) const
154	  {
155	    const AndesGate g = andes_gate_for(csr_addr);
156	    return g == AndesGate::ALWAYS || gate_on(g);
157	  }
158	};
159	
160	// The gated CSR names this core supports, for the --describe card. Iterates the
161	// two single-source-of-truth X-macro lists: the v3 Andes custom CSRs and the v4
162	// M-ext CSRs. The driver uses this list to gate --verify, so a CSR the core
163	// lacks is neither restored, drained, nor compared.
164	inline std::vector<std::string> supported_andes_csr_names(const AndesCaps& caps)
165	{
166	  std::vector<std::string> out;
167	#define X(field, addr, name) if (caps.supports_csr(addr)) out.push_back(name);
168	  HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST(X)
169	#undef X
170	  // PMA group markers (whole pmacfg[]/pmaaddr[] blocks share one gate), so a
171	  // consumer can include/exclude PMA without listing all 18 entries.
172	  if (caps.supports_csr(HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR))  out.push_back("pmacfg");
173	  if (caps.supports_csr(HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR)) out.push_back("pmaaddr");
174	  // v4 M-ext CSRs share the same address->gate map and --describe list.
175	#define X(field, addr, name) if (caps.supports_csr(addr)) out.push_back(name);
176	  HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST(X)
177	#undef X
178	  return out;
179	}
180	
181	}  // namespace hybrid
182	
183	#endif  // ANDES_HYBRID_ANDES_CAPS_HPP
184

    (defined(_NDS_ILM_ECC_TYPE_INT)    && _NDS_ILM_ECC_TYPE_INT)    || \

#endif

  c.set(AndesGate::SMRNMI);        // mnscratch/mnepc/mncause/mnstatus/mnvec/mrnxvec

#if defined(_NDS_EXCSLVL) && (_NDS_EXCSLVL > 0)

  c.set(AndesGate::PPI);           // mppib
#endif

    (defined(_NDS_FIO) && _NDS_FIO)
  c.set(AndesGate::FIO);           // mfiob

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Classify every spec CSR by its hybrid-handoff transport disposition.

The OFFLINE mirror of the wire-format transport set. It reads the spec inventory
snapshot (tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv, produced by extract_csr_inventory.py)
and assigns each CSR a disposition under the supported envelope: bare-metal,
single-hart, M-mode or M+U-mode, trap-free ROI.

The policy here must match what include/hybrid/state_abi.h actually transports.
The guard test (tests/andes_csr/test_csr_coverage_complete.*) cross-checks the
two, so a CSR added to the ABI without a matching disposition (or vice versa)
fails CI -- the "nothing missed" flywheel.

Dispositions (see docs/csr_coverage.ipynb for the full legend):
  TRANSPORT_NOW  already carried in hybrid_state_v1
  NEW            writable M-mode plain state -- expansion target
  NEW_TRIG       debug-trigger CSR (shares the Debug Module; transported guarded)
  NEW_UDELTA     U-mode Andes control; transported, exercised only in M+U
  CONST_RO       read-only config/info -- engine derives it; nothing to exchange
  EXCL_RV32      RV32 high-half shadow -- irrelevant on RV64
  EXCL_SIDEFX    read/write has side effects -- not architectural state
  EXCL_W1C_HW    write-1-clear, hardware-driven (like mip)
  EXCL_INDIRECT  miselect/mireg access mechanism, not a direct register
  EXCL_NEXT      U-mode N-extension trap state (trap-free ROI + usually absent)
  EXCL_DEBUG     Debug-mode CSR the handoff itself drives
  EXCL_MODE      S-mode / Hypervisor -- outside the M / M+U envelope
  EXCL_TRAP      detailed trap-cause latch, live only after a trap

Usage:
  classify_csr_coverage.py <csr_inventory.csv>            # write csr_coverage.csv beside it
  classify_csr_coverage.py <csr_inventory.csv> --stdout   # print, do not write
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# CSRs already carried in hybrid_state_v1 today (Bucket A). Names as the spec
# summary tables print them (range rows kept verbatim, e.g. pmpaddr1~63).
TRANSPORT_NOW = {
    "mstatus", "mepc", "mtvec", "mcause", "mtval", "mscratch", "medeleg",
    "mideleg", "mie", "mip", "mcycle", "minstret", "satp", "fcsr", "frm",
    "fﬂags",  # "fflags" with the fi-ligature the PDF emits
    "JVT", "mcache_ctl", "mmisc_ctl", "mxstatus", "mpft_ctl", "mclk_ctl",
    "milmb", "mdlmb", "mecc_code", "mhsp_ctl", "msp_bound", "msp_base",
    "mcountermask_m", "uitb", "ucode",
    "pmpcfg0", "pmpcfg1", "pmpcfg2", "pmpcfg3", "pmpcfg4~15",
    "pmpaddr0", "pmpaddr1~63",
    "pmacfg0", "pmacfg2", "pmaaddr0~47",
}

# Per-name decisions that override the structural defaults below.
OVERRIDE = {
    "misa": "CONST_RO", "tinfo": "CONST_RO", "tdata3": "CONST_RO",
    "mintstatus": "EXCL_RO",
    # side-effecting: reading or writing performs an action, so the value is not
    # state to round-trip.
    "mnxti": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "mscratchcsw": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
    "mscratchcswl": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "mcctlcommand": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
    "mintsel_jal": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "pushmcause": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
    "pushmepc": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "pushmxstatus": "EXCL_SIDEFX",
    "wfe": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "txevt": "EXCL_SIDEFX", "ucctlcommand": "EXCL_SIDEFX",

    "miselect": "EXCL_INDIRECT", "mireg": "EXCL_INDIRECT",

    "mireg4": "EXCL_INDIRECT", "mireg5": "EXCL_INDIRECT",
    "mireg6": "EXCL_INDIRECT",

    "dscratch1": "EXCL_DEBUG", "scontext": "EXCL_MODE",
    # writable M-mode plain state to add (the expansion).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the ax46mpv_advanced CSR registration manifest.

Joins, per spec-inventory CSR:
  - spec existence condition (per-CSR 'IM Requirement:' section text, else
    Table 13 of the SPA, hand-transcribed below)
  - access mode (per-CSR 'Access Mode:' line, else derived from priv column)
  - implemented on THIS engine (kv_csr_dec.v existent_csr evaluated with the
    build config.inc of Vax46mpv_advanced)
  - transported / claimed (state_abi.h membership + andes_caps gate evaluated
    for this engine; claimed set cross-checked against `--describe`)
  - gate/disposition (csr_coverage.csv decision + AndesGate)
  - empirical reset value (fresh reset-baseline capture, where the drain
    actually reads the CSR on this engine)
"""
import csv, re, sys
from pathlib import Path

SCRATCH = Path("/tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/df2dad97-908a-4704-b586-c6f23593ffdf/scratchpad")
REPO = Path("/home/nick/work/andesim")
OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else SCRATCH / "csr_manifest.csv"

def norm(s):
    return s.replace("ﬁ", "fi").replace("ﬂ", "fl").strip()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- inventory
inv = []
with open(REPO / "tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        inv.append({k: norm(v) for k, v in row.items()})

cov = {}
with open(REPO / "tests/andes_csr/csr_coverage.csv") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        cov[(norm(row["addr"]), norm(row["name"]))] = norm(row["decision"])

# ------------------------------------------------- per-CSR spec section parse
text = (SCRATCH / "spa.txt").read_text()
lines = text.splitlines()
sections = {}  # name -> (im_req, access, addr)
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    m = re.match(r"Mnemonic Name:\s*(\S+)", lines[i])
    if not m:
        i += 1
        continue
    name = norm(m.group(1)).lower()
    im, access, addr = None, None, None
    j = i + 1
    im_parts = []
    while j < len(lines) and j < i + 25:
        l = lines[j].strip()
        m2 = re.match(r"IM Requirement:\s*(.*)", l)
        if m2:
            im_parts = [m2.group(1).strip()]
            k = j + 1
            while k < len(lines) and not re.match(r"Access Mode:", lines[k]):
                t = lines[k].strip()
                if t.startswith("•") or t.startswith("-"):
                    im_parts.append(t.lstrip("•- ").strip())
                else:
                    break
                k += 1
            j = k - 1
        m3 = re.match(r"Access Mode:\s*(.*)", l)
        if m3:
            access = m3.group(1).strip()
        m4 = re.match(r"CSR Address:\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)", l)
        if m4:
            addr = m4.group(1)
            break
        j += 1
    if im_parts:
        im = "; ".join(p for p in im_parts if p)
    if name not in sections and (im or access):
        sections[name] = (im, access, addr)
    i = j + 1

# --------------------------------------------- Table 13 (hand-transcribed)
T13 = {}
def t13(names, cond):
    for n in names.split():
        T13[n] = cond
t13("mvendorid marchid mimpid mhartid mstatus misa mie mtvec mscratch mepc "
    "mcause mtval mip mcycle minstret mhpmcounter3~6 mcountinhibit",
    "Always exist")
t13("mhpmevent3~6", "OF and *INH fields: mrvarch_cfg.sscofpmf==1; others: Always exist")
t13("mcounterinten mcounterovf", "mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1")
t13("mcounterwen mcountermask_m mcountermask_u",
    "(mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[20]==1)")
t13("mcountermask_s scountermask_m scountermask_s scountermask_u "
    "scounterinten scounterovf scountinhibit shpmevent3~6",
    "(mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[18]==1)")
t13("scountovf", "(mrvarch_cfg.sscofpmf==1) & (misa[18]==1)")
t13("mcycleh minstreth mhpmcounter3h~6h mhpmevent3h~6h", "Always exist for RV32")
t13("mcounteren", "misa[20]==1")
t13("scounteren", "misa[18]==1")
t13("medeleg mideleg", "(misa[18]==1) | (misa[13]==1)")
t13("menvcfg", "misa[20]==1")
t13("menvcfgh", "misa[20]==1, RV32 only")
t13("mslideleg slie slip sstatus sie sip sscratch stval stvec sepc scause "
    "sdcause sedeleg sideleg", "misa[18]==1")
t13("mcctlbeginaddr mcctlcommand mcctldata",
    "(micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0) & (mmsc_cfg.CCTLCSR==1)")
t13("ucctlbeginaddr ucctlcommand",
    "(misa[20]==1) & (micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0) & (mmsc_cfg.CCTLCSR==1)")
t13("scctldata",
    "(misa[18]==1) & (micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0) & (mmsc_cfg.CCTLCSR==1)")
t13("senvcfg", "misa[20]==1")
t13("pmpcfg0 pmpcfg2~14 pmpaddr0 pmpaddr1~63 pmpcfg4~15",
    "Always exist; WARL probing detects the number of entries")
t13("pmpcfg1 pmpcfg3~15", "Always exist for RV32 (odd cfg CSRs)")
t13("tselect mcontrol/tdata1 tdata2", "WARL probe of tselect enumerates triggers")
t13("tdata3", "Always return 0")
t13("dcsr dpc dscratch0 dscratch1 dexc2dbg ddcause", "Always exist")
t13("micm_cfg mdcm_cfg mmsc_cfg", "Always exist")
t13("mnvec mrnxvec mnscratch mnepc mncause mnstatus", "mrvarch_cfg3.Smrnmi==1")
t13("mmsc_cfg2", "misa.MXL==1 && mmsc_cfg.msc_ext==1 (RV32 only)")
t13("mmsc_cfg3", "RV64: mmsc_cfg.msc_ext3==1; RV32: mmsc_cfg2.msc_ext3==1")
t13("mmsc_cfg4", "mmsc_cfg3.msc_ext4==1 (RV32)")
t13("mvec_cfg", "misa.V==1 && mmsc_cfg.veccfg==1")
t13("mrvarch_cfg", "RV64: mmsc_cfg.RVARCH==1; RV32: mmsc_cfg2.RVARCH==1")
t13("mrvarch_cfg2", "misa.MXL==1 & mmsc_cfg2.RVARCH2==1 & mmsc_cfg2.RVARCH==1 (RV32 only)")
t13("mrvarch_cfg3", "RV64: mrvarch_cfg.MRVARCH_EXT3==1; RV32: mrvarch_cfg2.MRVARCH_EXT3")
t13("mccache_ctl_base", "mmsc_cfg.CCACHE==1")
t13("milmb", "micm_cfg.ILMB!=0")
t13("mdlmb", "mdcm_cfg.DLMB!=0")
t13("mecc_code", "mmsc_cfg.ECC==1")
t13("mhsp_ctl msp_bound msp_base", "mmsc_cfg.HSP==1 | mmsc_cfg.HSPO==1")
t13("mpft_ctl", "mmsc_cfg.PFT==1")
t13("mcache_ctl", "micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0")
t13("mmisc_ctl", "(mmsc_cfg.AEC==1) | (mmsc_cfg.VPLIC==1) | (mmsc_cfg.ECD==1) | (mmsc_cfg.EV5==1)")
t13("smisc_ctl", "misa[18]==1 && mmsc_cfg.AEC==1")
t13("mxstatus mdcause", "Always exist")

t13("msaveepc1 msavecause1 msavedcause1", "mmsc_cfg.EXCSLVL>0 | mmsc_cfg.CRASHSAVE==1")
t13("mcrash_statesave mstatus_crashsave", "mmsc_cfg.CRASHSAVE==1")
t13("msaveepc2 msavecause2 msavedcause2", "mmsc_cfg.EXCSLVL>1")
t13("mclk_ctl", "(misa.V==1) | (mmsc_cfg.BF16CVT==1)")
t13("uitb", "mmsc_cfg.ECD==1")
t13("cycle instret hpmcounter3~6", "misa[20]==1")
t13("cycleh timeh instreth hpmcounter3h~6h", "misa[20]==1, RV32 only")
t13("time", "misa[20]==1")
t13("fflags frm fcsr", "(misa[5]==1) | (misa[3]==1)")
t13("ustatus uie utvec uscratch uepc ucause utval uip udcause", "misa[13]==1")
t13("wfe sleepvalue txevt", "mmsc_cfg.ESLEEP==1")

t13("pmacfg4 pmacfg6 pmacfg8 pmacfg10",
    "mmsc_cfg.PPMA==1 & (mmsc_cfg3.PPMA_VER==2 | mmsc_cfg4.PPMA_VER==2)")

    "mmsc_cfg.PPMA==1 & PPMA_VER==2 (RV32 only)")

def addr_list(addr_field):
    """inventory addr field -> list of ints (handles range rows)."""
    a = addr_field.replace("0x", "").replace("0X", "")
    m = re.match(r"^([0-9A-Fa-f]+)~(?:0x)?([0-9A-Fa-f]+)$", a)
    if m:
        lo = int(m.group(1), 16)
        hi_s = m.group(2)
        hi = int(hi_s, 16)
        if hi < lo:  # short-suffix ranges like 0xB03~6
            hi = int(m.group(1)[:-len(hi_s)] + hi_s, 16)
        return list(range(lo, hi + 1))
    return [int(a, 16)]

# --------------------------------------------------- transport / gate model

    0x324: "PERF_MONITOR", 0x325: "PERF_MONITOR", 0x326: "PERF_MONITOR",
    0x740: "SMRNMI", 0x741: "SMRNMI", 0x742: "SMRNMI", 0x744: "SMRNMI",
    0x7C3: "SMRNMI", 0x7DE: "SMRNMI",
    0x7C9: "ALWAYS",
    0x7D6: "EXCSLVL", 0x7D7: "EXCSLVL", 0x7D8: "EXCSLVL", 0x7D9: "EXCSLVL",
    0x7DA: "EXCSLVL", 0x7DB: "EXCSLVL", 0x7DC: "EXCSLVL",
    0x307: "CLIC", 0x347: "CLIC", 0x7EC: "CLIC",
    0x30C: "SMSTATEEN", 0x30D: "SMSTATEEN", 0x30E: "SMSTATEEN", 0x30F: "SMSTATEEN",
    0x7CB: "CCTL", 0x7CD: "CCTL", 0x7F0: "PPI", 0x7F1: "FIO",
    0x7A0: "TRIGGER", 0x7A1: "TRIGGER", 0x7A2: "TRIGGER", 0x7A5: "TRIGGER",
    0x7A8: "TRIGGER",
    0xBC0: "PMA", 0xBC2: "PMA", 0x7C4: "ALWAYS", 0x7DF: "ALWAYS",
}
for a in range(0xBD0, 0xBE0):
    GATE[a] = "PMA"

# wire-format membership (v3 Andes + v4 M-ext + core hybrid_state_v1 fields)
V3 = {0x7C4, 0x7C5, 0x7DF, 0x7C0, 0x7C1, 0x7C2, 0x7C6, 0x7C7, 0x7C8,
      0x7D1, 0x800, 0x017, 0x801, 0xBC0, 0xBC2} | set(range(0xBD0, 0xBE0))
V4 = {0x30A, 0x747, 0x306, 0x320, 0xB03, 0xB04, 0xB05, 0xB06,
      0x323, 0x324, 0x325, 0x326, 0x7CE, 0x7CF, 0x7D2, 0x7D3,
      0x740, 0x741, 0x742, 0x744, 0x7C3, 0x7DE, 0x7C9, 0x7D5,
      0x7D6, 0x7D7, 0x7D8, 0x7D9, 0x7DA, 0x7DB, 0x7DC,
      0x307, 0x347, 0x7EC, 0x30C, 0x30D, 0x30E, 0x30F, 0x7CB, 0x7CD,

BASE = {}
with open(SCRATCH / "baseline_dump.csv") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        BASE[row["field"]] = row["value"]
# fields the drain really reads on this engine (drain_with_passthrough +
# caps-gated sweep): core L23/L24 + counters + fcsr + claimed Andes/M-ext.
CLAIMED_NAMES = {"mxstatus", "mpft_ctl", "mclk_ctl", "milmb", "mdlmb",
                 "mhsp_ctl", "msp_bound", "msp_base", "uitb",
                 "mcountinhibit", "mhpmcounter3", "mhpmcounter4",
                 "mhpmcounter5", "mhpmcounter6", "mhpmevent3", "mhpmevent4",
                 "mhpmevent5", "mhpmevent6", "mdcause", "tselect", "tdata1",
                 "tdata2", "tcontrol", "mcontext"}
DRAIN_READ = ({"mscratch", "mepc", "mcause", "mtval", "mie", "mip",
               "mcycle", "minstret", "fcsr"} | CLAIMED_NAMES
              | {f"pmacfg{i}" for i in (0, 2)}
              | {f"pmaaddr{i}" for i in range(16)})

def empirical(name, addrs):
    n = name
    if n == "mcontrol/tdata1":
        n = "tdata1"
    if n in ("fflags", "frm"):
        return "0x0 (fcsr=0x0)" if n in DRAIN_READ or True else ""
    if n == "mhpmcounter3~6":
        return "0x0 (all of 3..6)"
    if n == "mhpmevent3~6":
        return "0x0 (all of 3..6)"
    if n == "pmaaddr0~47":
        return "0x0 (pmaaddr0..15; 16..47 absent)"
    if n in BASE and n in DRAIN_READ:
        return BASE[n]
    return ""

# verify exclusions (driver/state_diff.cpp andes_verify_excluded + core)
VERIFY_EXCL = {"msp_bound", "msp_base", "milmb", "mdlmb", "mhpmcounter3",

for r in inv:

    im = sec[0] if sec and sec[0] else None

    present = [a in PRESENT for a in addrs]
    if all(present):

    elif not any(present):

    else:
        got = [a for a, p in zip(addrs, present) if p]
        impl = f"partial ({len(got)}/{len(addrs)}: 0x{got[0]:X}..0x{got[-1]:X})"
    # special-case notes for partial groups
    if r["addr"] == "0x3A4~3AF":
        impl = "partial (even cfg CSRs only on RV64)"
    if r["addr"] == "0xBD0~0xBFF":
        impl = "partial (pmaaddr0..15 = 0xBD0..0xBDF only)"

    # transported / claimed on this engine
    gate = GATE.get(a0, "ALWAYS" if (a0 in V3 or a0 in V4) else "")
    in_abi = a0 in V3 or a0 in V4 or a0 in CORE_FULL or a0 in CORE_DRAIN_ONLY \
             or a0 in CORE_PMP or all(a in CORE_PMP for a in addrs)
    if a0 in CORE_FULL or (addrs and all(a in CORE_PMP for a in addrs)):
        if a0 in CORE_PMP:
            transported = "yes (core PMP mirror; restored only for S/U handoffs)"
        elif a0 in (0x7CA, 0x7D0):
            transported = "yes (core; restored, not re-drained)"
        elif a0 == 0x305:
            transported = "yes (core; restored, not re-drained)"
        else:
            transported = "yes (core)"
        gate_disp = f"{disp} / core"
    elif a0 in CORE_DRAIN_ONLY:
        transported = "drain-only record (S-mode; not restored on M-only engine)"
        gate_disp = f"{disp} / core (S/U envelope deferred)"
    elif a0 in V3 or a0 in V4:
        blk = "v3" if a0 in V3 else "v4"
        on = gate in GATES_ON
        transported = "yes (claimed)" if on else "no (gate off on this engine)"
        gate_disp = f"{disp} / {blk} AndesGate::{gate}"
    else:
        transported = "no (not in wire format)"
        gate_disp = disp

    emp = empirical(name, addrs)
    if name in ("fflags", "frm", "fcsr"):
        emp = "0x0"
    if name == "mcycle":
        emp = BASE.get("mcycle", "") + " (hart free-ran ~260 cycles before DMI halt)"

    notes = ""
    if name in VERIFY_EXCL or (name == "mcontrol/tdata1"):
        notes = "verify-excluded (engine/QEMU reset divergence or HW-driven)"
    if name == "mip":
        notes = "restored + re-read, NOT verify-compared (HW pending bits)"
    if name == "mtvec":
        notes = "restored, not re-drained"
    # under-claim findings
    if a0 == 0x7C3:
        notes = ("UNDER-CLAIM: RTL implements mnvec unconditionally (legacy "
                 "Andes NMI base) but gate SMRNMI is off (no Smrnmi)")
    if a0 in (0x7CB, 0x7CD):
        notes = ("UNDER-CLAIM: RTL implements it (CACHE_SUPPORT_INT=1) but "
                 "gate CCTL binds to _NDS_CCTLCSR/_NDS_CCTL, absent in this "
                 "config generation")
    if a0 == 0x813:
        notes = ("UNDER-CLAIM: RTL implements it (BFLOAT16_ARITH|ACE) but "
                 "gate UMODE is off; spec condition is ALT_FP_FMT|CST_CTL, "
                 "not U-mode")

    rows_out.append({
        "addr": r["addr"], "name": name, "access_mode": access,
        "spec_existence_condition": cond,
        "implemented_on_ax46mpv_advanced": impl,
        "transported": transported,
        "gate_disposition": gate_disp,
        "empirical_reset_value": emp,
        "notes": notes,
    })

with open(OUT, "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows_out[0].keys()))
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(rows_out)
print(f"wrote {OUT} ({len(rows_out)} rows)")

# quick summary for the report

claimed = sum(1 for r in rows_out if r["transported"].startswith("yes"))
under = [r["name"] for r in rows_out if r["notes"].startswith("UNDER-CLAIM")]
print(f"implemented(full or partial): {impl_yes}/{len(rows_out)}; "
      f"transported-yes rows: {claimed}; under-claims: {under}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the ax46mpv_advanced CSR registration manifest.

Joins, per spec-inventory CSR:
  - spec existence condition (per-CSR 'IM Requirement:' section text, else
    Table 13 of the SPA, hand-transcribed below)
  - access mode (per-CSR 'Access Mode:' line, else derived from priv column)
  - implemented on THIS engine (kv_csr_dec.v existent_csr evaluated with the
    build config.inc of Vax46mpv_advanced)
  - transported / claimed (state_abi.h membership + andes_caps gate evaluated
    for this engine; claimed set cross-checked against `--describe`)
  - gate/disposition (csr_coverage.csv decision + AndesGate)
  - empirical reset value (fresh reset-baseline capture, where the drain
    actually reads the CSR on this engine)
"""
import csv, re, sys
from pathlib import Path

SCRATCH = Path("/tmp/claude-1002/-home-nick-work-andesim/df2dad97-908a-4704-b586-c6f23593ffdf/scratchpad")
REPO = Path("/home/nick/work/andesim")
OUT = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else SCRATCH / "csr_manifest.csv"

def norm(s):
    return s.replace("ﬁ", "fi").replace("ﬂ", "fl").strip()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- inventory
inv = []
with open(REPO / "tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        inv.append({k: norm(v) for k, v in row.items()})

cov = {}
with open(REPO / "tests/andes_csr/csr_coverage.csv") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        cov[(norm(row["addr"]), norm(row["name"]))] = norm(row["decision"])

# ------------------------------------------------- per-CSR spec section parse
text = (SCRATCH / "spa.txt").read_text()
lines = text.splitlines()
sections = {}  # name -> (im_req, access, addr)
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    m = re.match(r"Mnemonic Name:\s*(\S+)", lines[i])
    if not m:
        i += 1
        continue
    name = norm(m.group(1)).lower()
    im, access, addr = None, None, None
    j = i + 1
    im_parts = []
    while j < len(lines) and j < i + 25:
        l = lines[j].strip()
        m2 = re.match(r"IM Requirement:\s*(.*)", l)
        if m2:
            im_parts = [m2.group(1).strip()]
            k = j + 1
            while k < len(lines) and not re.match(r"Access Mode:", lines[k]):
                t = lines[k].strip()
                if t.startswith("•") or t.startswith("-"):
                    im_parts.append(t.lstrip("•- ").strip())
                else:
                    break
                k += 1
            j = k - 1
        m3 = re.match(r"Access Mode:\s*(.*)", l)
        if m3:
            access = m3.group(1).strip()
        m4 = re.match(r"CSR Address:\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+)", l)
        if m4:
            addr = m4.group(1)
            break
        j += 1
    if im_parts:
        im = "; ".join(p for p in im_parts if p)
    if name not in sections and (im or access):
        sections[name] = (im, access, addr)
    i = j + 1

# --------------------------------------------- Table 13 (hand-transcribed)
T13 = {}
def t13(names, cond):
    for n in names.split():
        T13[n] = cond
t13("mvendorid marchid mimpid mhartid mstatus misa mie mtvec mscratch mepc "
    "mcause mtval mip mcycle minstret mhpmcounter3~6 mcountinhibit",
    "Always exist")
t13("mhpmevent3~6", "OF and *INH fields: mrvarch_cfg.sscofpmf==1; others: Always exist")

t13("mcounterwen mcountermask_m mcountermask_u",
    "(mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[20]==1)")
t13("mcountermask_s scountermask_m scountermask_s scountermask_u "
    "scounterinten scounterovf scountinhibit shpmevent3~6",
    "(mmsc_cfg.PMNDS==1) & (misa[18]==1)")
t13("scountovf", "(mrvarch_cfg.sscofpmf==1) & (misa[18]==1)")
t13("mcycleh minstreth mhpmcounter3h~6h mhpmevent3h~6h", "Always exist for RV32")
t13("mcounteren", "misa[20]==1")
t13("scounteren", "misa[18]==1")
t13("medeleg mideleg", "(misa[18]==1) | (misa[13]==1)")
t13("menvcfg", "misa[20]==1")
t13("menvcfgh", "misa[20]==1, RV32 only")
t13("mslideleg slie slip sstatus sie sip sscratch stval stvec sepc scause "
    "sdcause sedeleg sideleg", "misa[18]==1")

    "(micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0) & (mmsc_cfg.CCTLCSR==1)")

    "(misa[20]==1) & (micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0) & (mmsc_cfg.CCTLCSR==1)")
t13("scctldata",
    "(misa[18]==1) & (micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0) & (mmsc_cfg.CCTLCSR==1)")
t13("senvcfg", "misa[20]==1")
t13("pmpcfg0 pmpcfg2~14 pmpaddr0 pmpaddr1~63 pmpcfg4~15",
    "Always exist; WARL probing detects the number of entries")
t13("pmpcfg1 pmpcfg3~15", "Always exist for RV32 (odd cfg CSRs)")
t13("tselect mcontrol/tdata1 tdata2", "WARL probe of tselect enumerates triggers")

t13("micm_cfg mdcm_cfg mmsc_cfg", "Always exist")
t13("mnvec mrnxvec mnscratch mnepc mncause mnstatus", "mrvarch_cfg3.Smrnmi==1")
t13("mmsc_cfg2", "misa.MXL==1 && mmsc_cfg.msc_ext==1 (RV32 only)")

t13("mrvarch_cfg2", "misa.MXL==1 & mmsc_cfg2.RVARCH2==1 & mmsc_cfg2.RVARCH==1 (RV32 only)")
t13("mrvarch_cfg3", "RV64: mrvarch_cfg.MRVARCH_EXT3==1; RV32: mrvarch_cfg2.MRVARCH_EXT3")
t13("mccache_ctl_base", "mmsc_cfg.CCACHE==1")
t13("milmb", "micm_cfg.ILMB!=0")
t13("mdlmb", "mdcm_cfg.DLMB!=0")
t13("mecc_code", "mmsc_cfg.ECC==1")
t13("mhsp_ctl msp_bound msp_base", "mmsc_cfg.HSP==1 | mmsc_cfg.HSPO==1")
t13("mpft_ctl", "mmsc_cfg.PFT==1")
t13("mcache_ctl", "micm_cfg.ISZ!=0 | mdcm_cfg.DSZ!=0")
t13("mmisc_ctl", "(mmsc_cfg.AEC==1) | (mmsc_cfg.VPLIC==1) | (mmsc_cfg.ECD==1) | (mmsc_cfg.EV5==1)")
t13("smisc_ctl", "misa[18]==1 && mmsc_cfg.AEC==1")
t13("mxstatus mdcause", "Always exist")
t13("msavestatus", "mmsc_cfg.EXCSLVL>0")
t13("msaveepc1 msavecause1 msavedcause1", "mmsc_cfg.EXCSLVL>0 | mmsc_cfg.CRASHSAVE==1")
t13("mcrash_statesave mstatus_crashsave", "mmsc_cfg.CRASHSAVE==1")
t13("msaveepc2 msavecause2 msavedcause2", "mmsc_cfg.EXCSLVL>1")
t13("mclk_ctl", "(misa.V==1) | (mmsc_cfg.BF16CVT==1)")
t13("uitb", "mmsc_cfg.ECD==1")
t13("cycle instret hpmcounter3~6", "misa[20]==1")
t13("cycleh timeh instreth hpmcounter3h~6h", "misa[20]==1, RV32 only")
t13("time", "misa[20]==1")
t13("fflags frm fcsr", "(misa[5]==1) | (misa[3]==1)")
t13("ustatus uie utvec uscratch uepc ucause utval uip udcause", "misa[13]==1")
t13("wfe sleepvalue txevt", "mmsc_cfg.ESLEEP==1")
t13("mtvt mnxti mintstatus mscratchcsw mscratchcswl", "mmsc_cfg.CLIC==1")
t13("ucode", "mmsc_cfg.EDSP==1")
t13("mirq_entry mintsel_jal pushmcause pushmepc pushmxstatus", "mmsc_cfg.ECLIC==1")
t13("mppib", "mmsc_cfg.PPI==1")
t13("mfiob", "mmsc_cfg.FIO==1")
t13("pmacfg0 pmacfg2 pmaaddr0~47", "mmsc_cfg.PPMA==1 (pmaaddr16~47: also PPMA_VER==2)")
t13("pmacfg4 pmacfg6 pmacfg8 pmacfg10",
    "mmsc_cfg.PPMA==1 & (mmsc_cfg3.PPMA_VER==2 | mmsc_cfg4.PPMA_VER==2)")
t13("pmacfg1 pmacfg3", "mmsc_cfg.PPMA==1 (RV32 only)")
t13("pmacfg5 pmacfg7 pmacfg9 pmacfg11",
    "mmsc_cfg.PPMA==1 & PPMA_VER==2 (RV32 only)")
t13("umisc_ctl", "RV64: mmsc_cfg.ALT_FP_FMT==1 | mmsc_cfg3.CST_CTL==1")
t13("mhvmb mhvm_cfg", "mmsc_cfg3.HVMCSR==1")
t13("ml1dbf_cfg", "RV64: mmsc_cfg3.L1D_BF==1; RV32: mmsc_cfg4.L1D_BF==1")

# ------------------------------------- engine existence (kv_csr_dec.v eval)

def addr_list(addr_field):
    """inventory addr field -> list of ints (handles range rows)."""
    a = addr_field.replace("0x", "").replace("0X", "")
    m = re.match(r"^([0-9A-Fa-f]+)~(?:0x)?([0-9A-Fa-f]+)$", a)
    if m:
        lo = int(m.group(1), 16)
        hi_s = m.group(2)
        hi = int(hi_s, 16)
        if hi < lo:  # short-suffix ranges like 0xB03~6
            hi = int(m.group(1)[:-len(hi_s)] + hi_s, 16)
        return list(range(lo, hi + 1))
    return [int(a, 16)]

GATES_ON = {"ALWAYS", "CODENSE", "POWERBRAKE", "STACKSAFE", "PERF_MONITOR",

GATE = {  # addr -> AndesGate (andes_gate_for)
    0x801: "DSP", 0x800: "CODENSE", 0x017: "ZCMT", 0x7C5: "POWERBRAKE",
    0x7C2: "ECC", 0x7C6: "STACKSAFE", 0x7C7: "STACKSAFE", 0x7C8: "STACKSAFE",
    0x7C0: "ILM", 0x7C1: "DLM",
    0x7CF: "PMNDS", 0x7CE: "PMNDS_UMODE", 0x7D1: "PMNDS_UMODE",
    0x7D3: "PMNDS_UMODE", 0x7D2: "PMNDS_SMODE",
    0x30A: "UMODE", 0x306: "UMODE", 0x808: "UMODE", 0x80B: "UMODE",
    0x811: "UMODE", 0x813: "UMODE",
    0x7D5: "SMODE", 0x747: "EPMP",
    0x320: "PERF_MONITOR", 0xB03: "PERF_MONITOR", 0xB04: "PERF_MONITOR",
    0xB05: "PERF_MONITOR", 0xB06: "PERF_MONITOR", 0x323: "PERF_MONITOR",
    0x324: "PERF_MONITOR", 0x325: "PERF_MONITOR", 0x326: "PERF_MONITOR",
    0x740: "SMRNMI", 0x741: "SMRNMI", 0x742: "SMRNMI", 0x744: "SMRNMI",
    0x7C3: "SMRNMI", 0x7DE: "SMRNMI",
    0x7C9: "ALWAYS",
    0x7D6: "EXCSLVL", 0x7D7: "EXCSLVL", 0x7D8: "EXCSLVL", 0x7D9: "EXCSLVL",
    0x7DA: "EXCSLVL", 0x7DB: "EXCSLVL", 0x7DC: "EXCSLVL",
    0x307: "CLIC", 0x347: "CLIC", 0x7EC: "CLIC",
    0x30C: "SMSTATEEN", 0x30D: "SMSTATEEN", 0x30E: "SMSTATEEN", 0x30F: "SMSTATEEN",
    0x7CB: "CCTL", 0x7CD: "CCTL", 0x7F0: "PPI", 0x7F1: "FIO",
    0x7A0: "TRIGGER", 0x7A1: "TRIGGER", 0x7A2: "TRIGGER", 0x7A5: "TRIGGER",
    0x7A8: "TRIGGER",
    0xBC0: "PMA", 0xBC2: "PMA", 0x7C4: "ALWAYS", 0x7DF: "ALWAYS",
}
for a in range(0xBD0, 0xBE0):
    GATE[a] = "PMA"

# wire-format membership (v3 Andes + v4 M-ext + core hybrid_state_v1 fields)
V3 = {0x7C4, 0x7C5, 0x7DF, 0x7C0, 0x7C1, 0x7C2, 0x7C6, 0x7C7, 0x7C8,
      0x7D1, 0x800, 0x017, 0x801, 0xBC0, 0xBC2} | set(range(0xBD0, 0xBE0))
V4 = {0x30A, 0x747, 0x306, 0x320, 0xB03, 0xB04, 0xB05, 0xB06,
      0x323, 0x324, 0x325, 0x326, 0x7CE, 0x7CF, 0x7D2, 0x7D3,
      0x740, 0x741, 0x742, 0x744, 0x7C3, 0x7DE, 0x7C9, 0x7D5,
      0x7D6, 0x7D7, 0x7D8, 0x7D9, 0x7DA, 0x7DB, 0x7DC,
      0x307, 0x347, 0x7EC, 0x30C, 0x30D, 0x30E, 0x30F, 0x7CB, 0x7CD,
      0x7F0, 0x7F1, 0x7A0, 0x7A1, 0x7A2, 0x7A5, 0x7A8,
      0x808, 0x80B, 0x811, 0x813}

             0xB00, 0xB02, 0x001, 0x002, 0x003, 0x7CA, 0x7D0}
CORE_DRAIN_ONLY = {0x302, 0x303, 0x180}  # S-mode: drained record only
CORE_PMP = ({0x3A0, 0x3A1, 0x3A2, 0x3A3} | set(range(0x3A4, 0x3B0))
            | set(range(0x3B0, 0x3F0)))

BASE = {}
with open(SCRATCH / "baseline_dump.csv") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        BASE[row["field"]] = row["value"]
# fields the drain really reads on this engine (drain_with_passthrough +
# caps-gated sweep): core L23/L24 + counters + fcsr + claimed Andes/M-ext.
CLAIMED_NAMES = {"mxstatus", "mpft_ctl", "mclk_ctl", "milmb", "mdlmb",
                 "mhsp_ctl", "msp_bound", "msp_base", "uitb",
                 "mcountinhibit", "mhpmcounter3", "mhpmcounter4",
                 "mhpmcounter5", "mhpmcounter6", "mhpmevent3", "mhpmevent4",
                 "mhpmevent5", "mhpmevent6", "mdcause", "tselect", "tdata1",
                 "tdata2", "tcontrol", "mcontext"}
DRAIN_READ = ({"mscratch", "mepc", "mcause", "mtval", "mie", "mip",
               "mcycle", "minstret", "fcsr"} | CLAIMED_NAMES
              | {f"pmacfg{i}" for i in (0, 2)}
              | {f"pmaaddr{i}" for i in range(16)})

def empirical(name, addrs):
    n = name
    if n == "mcontrol/tdata1":
        n = "tdata1"
    if n in ("fflags", "frm"):
        return "0x0 (fcsr=0x0)" if n in DRAIN_READ or True else ""
    if n == "mhpmcounter3~6":
        return "0x0 (all of 3..6)"
    if n == "mhpmevent3~6":
        return "0x0 (all of 3..6)"
    if n == "pmaaddr0~47":
        return "0x0 (pmaaddr0..15; 16..47 absent)"
    if n in BASE and n in DRAIN_READ:
        return BASE[n]
    return ""

VERIFY_EXCL = {"msp_bound", "msp_base", "milmb", "mdlmb", "mhpmcounter3",
               "mhpmcounter4", "mhpmcounter5", "mhpmcounter6", "mdcause",
               "tdata1", "tcontrol", "mcontext"}

rows_out = []
for r in inv:
    name = r["name"]
    addrs = addr_list(r["addr"])
    a0 = addrs[0]
    key = (r["addr"], r["name"])
    disp = cov.get(key, "?")

    # spec existence + access mode
    sec = sections.get(name.lower().split("/")[0]) or sections.get(name.lower())
    im = sec[0] if sec and sec[0] else None
    access = sec[1] if sec and sec[1] else None
    cond = T13.get(name) or im or "-"
    if not access:
        p = r["priv"]
        access = {"M": "Machine", "S": "Supervisor", "U": "User", "D": "Debug",
                  "H": "Hypervisor"}.get(p[0], p)

    # engine implementation (RTL existent_csr eval)
    present = [a in PRESENT for a in addrs]
    if all(present):
        impl = "yes"
    elif not any(present):
        impl = "no"
    else:
        got = [a for a, p in zip(addrs, present) if p]
        impl = f"partial ({len(got)}/{len(addrs)}: 0x{got[0]:X}..0x{got[-1]:X})"
    # special-case notes for partial groups
    if r["addr"] == "0x3A4~3AF":
        impl = "partial (even cfg CSRs only on RV64)"
    if r["addr"] == "0xBD0~0xBFF":
        impl = "partial (pmaaddr0..15 = 0xBD0..0xBDF only)"

    # transported / claimed on this engine
    gate = GATE.get(a0, "ALWAYS" if (a0 in V3 or a0 in V4) else "")
    in_abi = a0 in V3 or a0 in V4 or a0 in CORE_FULL or a0 in CORE_DRAIN_ONLY \
             or a0 in CORE_PMP or all(a in CORE_PMP for a in addrs)
    if a0 in CORE_FULL or (addrs and all(a in CORE_PMP for a in addrs)):
        if a0 in CORE_PMP:
            transported = "yes (core PMP mirror; restored only for S/U handoffs)"
        elif a0 in (0x7CA, 0x7D0):
            transported = "yes (core; restored, not re-drained)"
        elif a0 == 0x305:
            transported = "yes (core; restored, not re-drained)"
        else:
            transported = "yes (core)"
        gate_disp = f"{disp} / core"
    elif a0 in CORE_DRAIN_ONLY:
        transported = "drain-only record (S-mode; not restored on M-only engine)"
        gate_disp = f"{disp} / core (S/U envelope deferred)"
    elif a0 in V3 or a0 in V4:
        blk = "v3" if a0 in V3 else "v4"
        on = gate in GATES_ON
        transported = "yes (claimed)" if on else "no (gate off on this engine)"
        gate_disp = f"{disp} / {blk} AndesGate::{gate}"
    else:
        transported = "no (not in wire format)"
        gate_disp = disp

    emp = empirical(name, addrs)
    if name in ("fflags", "frm", "fcsr"):
        emp = "0x0"
    if name == "mcycle":
        emp = BASE.get("mcycle", "") + " (hart free-ran ~260 cycles before DMI halt)"

    notes = ""
    if name in VERIFY_EXCL or (name == "mcontrol/tdata1"):
        notes = "verify-excluded (engine/QEMU reset divergence or HW-driven)"
    if name == "mip":
        notes = "restored + re-read, NOT verify-compared (HW pending bits)"
    if name == "mtvec":
        notes = "restored, not re-drained"
    # under-claim findings
    if a0 == 0x7C3:
        notes = ("UNDER-CLAIM: RTL implements mnvec unconditionally (legacy "
                 "Andes NMI base) but gate SMRNMI is off (no Smrnmi)")
    if a0 in (0x7CB, 0x7CD):
        notes = ("UNDER-CLAIM: RTL implements it (CACHE_SUPPORT_INT=1) but "
                 "gate CCTL binds to _NDS_CCTLCSR/_NDS_CCTL, absent in this "
                 "config generation")
    if a0 == 0x813:
        notes = ("UNDER-CLAIM: RTL implements it (BFLOAT16_ARITH|ACE) but "
                 "gate UMODE is off; spec condition is ALT_FP_FMT|CST_CTL, "
                 "not U-mode")

    rows_out.append({
        "addr": r["addr"], "name": name, "access_mode": access,
        "spec_existence_condition": cond,
        "implemented_on_ax46mpv_advanced": impl,
        "transported": transported,
        "gate_disposition": gate_disp,
        "empirical_reset_value": emp,
        "notes": notes,
    })

with open(OUT, "w", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(rows_out[0].keys()))
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(rows_out)
print(f"wrote {OUT} ({len(rows_out)} rows)")

# quick summary for the report
impl_yes = sum(1 for r in rows_out if r["implemented_on_ax46mpv_advanced"].startswith(("yes", "partial")))
claimed = sum(1 for r in rows_out if r["transported"].startswith("yes"))
under = [r["name"] for r in rows_out if r["notes"].startswith("UNDER-CLAIM")]
print(f"implemented(full or partial): {impl_yes}/{len(rows_out)}; "
      f"transported-yes rows: {claimed}; under-claims: {under}")

input.content:
# ax46mpv_advanced: CSR transport registration report

Registration of the `vsim:ax46mpv_advanced` engine for commercial support:
full spec-inventory CSR manifest + two-direction completeness check.

- Manifest: `csr_manifest.csv` (232 rows = every row of
  `tests/andes_csr/csr_inventory.csv`, the checked-in snapshot of
  AndeStar_V5_SPA_UM164_V1.7)
- Supporting evidence: `reset_baseline_dump.csv` (decoded reset-baseline
  capture, raw `hybrid_state_v1`)
- No repo files were modified; no rebuilds; single runs only.

## 1. Engine ground truth

Sources (in the required priority order):

1. `$VSIM_BIN_DIR/Vax46mpv_advanced/obj_sc/config.inc` (the BUILD copy)
2. `sim_ax46mpv_advanced --describe`
3. The engine's own RTL CSR decoder,
   `Vax46mpv_advanced/andes_ip/kv_core/ucore/hdl/kv_csr_dec.v`
   (`existent_csr`), plus the `localparam` derivations in `kv_csr.v` --
   the per-address authority for "does a csrr of this CSR fault".

Key engine facts (config.inc):

| knob | value | consequence |
|------|-------|-------------|
| NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS | 1 | M-only: every UMODE/SMODE-gated CSR off; no user counters (0xC00...) |
| NDS_SSCOFPMF_SUPPORT | 1 | standard Sscofpmf REPLACES the Andes PMNDS scheme: mcounterwen/inten/mask_*/ovf absent |
| NDS_PERFORMANCE_MONITOR_INT / _COUNTER | 1 / 4 | mcountinhibit, mhpmcounter3-6, mhpmevent3-6 present |
| NDS_STACKSAFE_SUPPORT_INT | 1 | mhsp_ctl, msp_bound, msp_base present |
| NDS_POWERBRAKE_SUPPORT_INT | 1 | mpft_ctl present |
| NDS_CODENSE_SUPPORT_INT | 1 | uitb present (ucode needs DSP, absent) |
| NDS_ZCE_SUPPORT_INT | 0 | jvt (0x017) absent |
| NDS_DSP_SUPPORT_INT | 0 | ucode absent |
| NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB / NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB | 64 / 32 | milmb, mdlmb present |
| all ECC knobs (ILM/DLM/I$/D$/STLB/BTB) | 0/none | mecc_code absent |
| NDS_ICACHE_SIZE_KB / NDS_DCACHE_SIZE_KB | 64 / 64 | CACHE_SUPPORT_INT=1: mcache_ctl AND mcctlbeginaddr/mcctlcommand/mcctldata present |
| NDS_PMA_ENTRIES | 1 | pmacfg0/2 + pmaaddr0-15 present |
| NDS_PMP_ENTRIES | 1 | pmp CSRs decode as existent (WARL detects entry count) |
| NDS_NUM_TRIGGER | 2 | tselect/tdata1/tdata2/tdata3/tinfo/tcontrol/mcontext present |
| NDS_SMEPMP_SUPPORT | 0 | mseccfg absent |
| NDS_PPI_SIZE_KB | 0 | mppib absent; mfiob not decoded at all |
| NDS_WFE_SUPPORT_INT | 0 | wfe/sleepvalue/txevt absent |
| NDS_BFLOAT16_ARITH_SUPPORT / NDS_ACE_SUPPORT_INT | 1 / 1 | umisc_ctl (0x813) PRESENT; mmisc_ctl present |
| NDS_RVV_SUPPORT_INT (zve32x, VLEN 512) | 1 | mclk_ctl, mvec_cfg present; vlenb=0x40 |
| no _NDS_SMRNMI / _NDS_CLIC / _NDS_SMSTATEEN / _NDS_EXCSLVL knobs | absent | those gates read as off |

RTL notes that matter and are NOT visible from config.inc alone
(from `kv_csr.v` localparams and `kv_csr_dec.v`):

- `mnvec` (0x7C3) decodes as existent UNCONDITIONALLY on this core
  generation (legacy Andes NMI vector), even though the SPA Table 13 gates
  it on `mrvarch_cfg3.Smrnmi==1` and this engine has no Smrnmi.
- `CACHE_SUPPORT_INT = (ICACHE_SIZE_KB!=0)|(DCACHE_SIZE_KB!=0)|...` = 1,
  and it alone gates 0x7CA/0x7CB/0x7CC/0x7CD (no CCTLCSR term in the RTL).
- `umisc_ctl` (0x813) decodes on `(BFLOAT16_ARITH_SUPPORT==1)|(ACE==1)` = 1.
- `MMSC_CFG3_EXIST=1` (hardwired), `MRVARCH_CFG_EXIST=1` (RVV),
  `MRVARCH_CFG3_EXIST=1` (IMPD hardwired 1), `ML1DBF_CFG_EXIST=1`
  (DCACHE_UTAG), `MMSC_CFG2_EXIST=0`, `MRVARCH_CFG2_EXIST=0` -- these fix
  the 0xFCx info-CSR rows (all CONST_RO, transport-irrelevant).
- mhpmcounter/mhpmevent decode for indices 3..31 even though only 4
  counters are configured (the extras are inventory-out-of-scope; the SPA
  documents 3~6 and the ABI transports 3~6).

## 2. Claimed transport set on this engine

`sim_ax46mpv_advanced --describe` -> `andes_csrs` (the caps-gated claims):

```
v3 Andes : mxstatus mpft_ctl mclk_ctl milmb mdlmb mhsp_ctl msp_bound
           msp_base uitb pmacfg(0xBC0,0xBC2) pmaaddr(0xBD0..0xBDF)
v4 M-ext : mcountinhibit mhpmcounter3-6 mhpmevent3-6 mdcause
           tselect tdata1 tdata2 tcontrol mcontext
```

This matches an independent re-derivation from `andes_caps.hpp` +
`andes_caps_config.hpp` against the build config.inc (gates ON: ALWAYS,
CODENSE, POWERBRAKE, STACKSAFE, PERF_MONITOR, PMA, ILM, DLM, TRIGGER).
Plus the always-carried core set: mstatus, mepc, mtvec(1), mcause, mtval,
mscratch, mie, mip, mcycle, minstret, fcsr(fflags/frm), mcache_ctl(1),
mmisc_ctl(1), the PMP mirror(2), and the drain-only S-mode records
medeleg/mideleg/satp(3).

(1) restored, not re-drained. (2) restored only for S/U handoffs; M-mode
keeps PMP pass-through. (3) drained record only; not restored on an
M-only engine (S/U-envelope work).

Manifest totals: 74/232 inventory rows implemented (fully or partially)
on this engine; 43 rows transported/claimed; 3 drain-only records.

## 3. Completeness check, direction 1: over-claims

Claim to prove: every caps-claimed CSR is really csrr-able on THIS RTL.
The tolerant abstract path masks over-claims (faulting reads mirror as
zero and --verify matches zero==zero), so the proof is the batched
Program-Buffer csr sweep that the reset-baseline capture rides over the
COMPLETE caps-supported list. Cold cache forces the capture:

```
rm -rf ~/.cache/andesim
./andesim run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:ax46mpv_advanced \
  --verify tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf
```

Result (2026-07-02):

```
[andesim] model=hybrid engine=vsim:ax46mpv_advanced vlen=512 trigger=marker fixture=rt_c_hello
```
